caller.remaining: Genuine phase scope, route, locks, duplicate eligibility and admission. The existing current checker must evaluate owner, exact native scope, true prior receipts, original expiry, independent verdict and retained source continuity at preclock and send boundaries.

saved_receiver.stand: Exact R4 new, send, and observe on disposable Store with inert transport and local simulated timestamps. Original 300-second deadline and 180-second reply window preserved.

saved_receiver.meaning: The exact whole saved answer can match all ten facts and coverage. Equivalent reason wording, contradictory text and source/provider lineage require independent evidence.
